description: This file contains ARM assembly code for cryptographic operations, specifically montgomery multiplication functions optimized for ARMv7 architecture with NEON support, used in BoringSSL's cryptography module.

methods.name: bn_mul_mont
methods.description: Performs Montgomery multiplication for big numbers, optimized for ARM architecture.

methods.name: bn_mul8x_mont_neon
methods.description: Optimized NEON implementation of Montgomery multiplication for 8x8 bit blocks.
